reviewed_claims: Distinct selected affine lines meet in at most one point; light pairs in one direction share only their Y point; distinct directions can share at most one copied point; light and heavy targets use disjoint point copies.
The only NOT is negation of AND(Y), so all inputs of weight below k satisfy z=1 and z(Y)=0.
On Y=1 every propagated C0 gate is exactly a constant or an OR of outside inputs; an OR mask contained in a heavy target implies global C0 soundness by monotonicity.
The singleton propagation is exact, and equals C1 singleton propagation because h has no singleton positives.
The control identities justify every original light and heavy output on all inputs without enumerating those inputs.
The eligible-pool overlap consists of the paired cherries and each final heavy output. Exact refunds consist of those final heavy outputs.
After Y=1, elementary alias/constant simplification retains exactly each heavy line OR tree and removes all switch gates and distributed clause gates.
scope_limits: This independent review did not rerun the large all-gate symbolic computation.
